positive.$description: Positive/on-track status foreground — green.700 (#15803D), 5.02:1 on background.primary (#FFFFFF), WCAG 2.2 AA (retargeted from green.600 #16A34A which was 3.30:1, FAIL). Hue preserved. Never color alone — pair with icon/label.

warning.$description: Warning/at-risk status foreground — amber.700 (#B45309), 5.02:1 on background.primary (#FFFFFF), WCAG 2.2 AA (retargeted from amber.600 #D97706 which was 3.19:1, FAIL). Hue preserved. Never color alone — pair with icon/label.

pending.$description: Pending/in-progress (authorizing, syncing, processing) — teal.700, 4.8:1 on white (AA). Distinct hue from info/warning; always pair with a clock/spinner icon + label, never color alone.

neutral.$description: Neutral/uncategorized/cleared-unremarkable — neutral.500, 4.8:1 on white (AA). Pair with label, never color alone.

positiveSubtle.$description: Low-emphasis positive background (badge/banner/row). Pair with status.positive (green.700) foreground — 6.3:1 (AA).

negativeSubtle.$description: Low-emphasis negative background. Pair with status.negative (red.700) — 6.5:1 (AA).

warningSubtle.$description: Low-emphasis warning background. Pair with status.warning (amber.700) — 5.6:1 (AA).

infoSubtle.$description: Low-emphasis info background. Pair with status.info (blue.700) — 6.9:1 (AA).

pendingSubtle.$description: Low-emphasis pending pill background. Pair with status.pending (teal.700) — 5.7:1 (AA).

neutralSubtle.$description: Low-emphasis neutral background. Pair with text.primary or status.neutral — 4.8:1+ (AA).
